name: spawn-policy
description: Enforces the role-to-model map and synchronous review dispatch on agent.spawn in autonomous sessions, and logs every rewrite

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.description: auto rewrites only in autonomous sessions (the auto skill has run, or the spawn's permission mode is auto) and logs elsewhere; always rewrites everywhere; never only logs.

developer_model.title: developer model
developer_model.description: Model alias or id every developer spawn runs on.

verifier_model.title: quality-verifier model
verifier_model.description: Model alias or id every quality-verifier spawn runs on.

reviewer_model.title: quality-reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model alias or id every quality-reviewer spawn runs on.

sync_review_dispatch.title: Synchronous review dispatch
sync_review_dispatch.description: Rewrite run_in_background to false on main-loop spawns of quality-reviewer, quality-verifier and developer.

ledger.title: Write ledger
ledger.description: Append one JSONL row per decision to tmp/spawn-policy-<session>.jsonl under the checkout that owns the session root.
